from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory


ROOT = Path("/Users/kangsangmo/Desktop/Valuehire_v6/worktrees/hs-0002-20260910")
HELPER = ROOT / "scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
TESTS = ROOT / "humansearch/tests"


def clean_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        key: value
        for key, value in os.environ.items()
        if not key.startswith("GIT_") and key not in {"BASH_ENV", "ENV"}
    }


def run_helper(path: Path, expected: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(HELPER), str(path), expected],
        cwd=ROOT,
        env=clean_env(),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
    )


def main() -> int:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(TESTS))
    from test_hs_0002 import call_negative  # noqa: PLC0415

    results: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="codeaudit-final-probes-") as tmp_name:
        tmp = Path(tmp_name)

        cases = [
            ("cli-normal", "FAIL: reason\n", "reason", 0),
            ("cli-mismatch", "FAIL: unrelated reason\n", "reason", 1),
            ("cli-empty-expected", "FAIL: \n", "", 1),
            ("cli-space-expected", "FAIL:  \n", " ", 1),
            ("cli-literal-leading-space", "FAIL:  literal \n", " literal ", 0),
            ("cli-leading-space-mismatch", "FAIL: literal\n", " literal ", 1),
            ("cli-cr-expected", "FAIL: reason\rX\n", "reason\rX", 1),
            ("cli-lf-expected", "FAIL: reason\nX\n", "reason\nX", 1),
            ("cli-slash-boundary", "FAIL: reason/details\n", "reason", 0),
            ("cli-punctuation-boundary", "FAIL: reason-details\n", "reason", 1),
        ]
        for name, content, expected, wanted_rc in cases:
            path = tmp / f"{name}.log"
            path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
            proc = run_helper(path, expected)
            results.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "kind": "helper-cli",
                    "exit_code": proc.returncode,
                    "expected_exit_code": wanted_rc,
                    "stdout": proc.stdout,
                    "stderr": proc.stderr,
                    "passed": proc.returncode == wanted_rc,
                }
            )

        invalid = tmp / "invalid.log"
        invalid.write_bytes(b"FAIL: reason\xff")
        directory = tmp / "directory"
        directory.mkdir()
        file_error_cases = [
            ("cli-missing-file", tmp / "missing.log", "reason", 2),
            ("cli-directory", directory, "reason", 2),
            ("cli-invalid-utf8", invalid, "reason", 2),
        ]
        for name, path, expected, wanted_rc in file_error_cases:
            proc = run_helper(path, expected)
            results.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "kind": "helper-cli-file-error",
                    "exit_code": proc.returncode,
                    "expected_exit_code": wanted_rc,
                    "stdout": proc.stdout,
                    "stderr": proc.stderr,
                    "passed": proc.returncode == wanted_rc and bool(proc.stderr),
                }
            )

        negative_cases = [
            ("negative-blank-reject", "FAIL:  ", " ", 1),
            ("negative-leading-space-accept", "FAIL:  literal ", " literal ", 0),
            ("negative-pass-bait-reject", "PASS: reason\nFAIL: unrelated", "reason", 1),
            ("negative-slash-boundary-accept", "FAIL: reason/details", "reason", 0),
            ("negative-punctuation-reject", "FAIL: reason-details", "reason", 1),
        ]
        for name, output, expected, wanted_rc in negative_cases:
            proc = call_negative(tmp, output, expected)
            results.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "kind": "actual-negative-function",
                    "exit_code": proc.returncode,
                    "expected_exit_code": wanted_rc,
                    "stdout": proc.stdout,
                    "stderr": proc.stderr,
                    "passed": proc.returncode == wanted_rc and "CHECKED: 1" in proc.stdout,
                }
            )

    print(json.dumps({"results": results}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0 if all(bool(item["passed"]) for item in results) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
